verdict.rationale: Obsidian core storage is plain-text Markdown files on local disk with no proprietary lock-in, explicitly marketed as future-proof so notes 'outlive the app,' and this is corroborated by independent user reports of migrating away and still having usable text files. missing for 10: independent long-term archival/format-stability audit and clarity on the newer Canvas JSON format's durability (community notes flag it as less readable than Markdown, a minor caveat).
